from z3 import *

X = [[Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}") for j in range(12)] for i in range(12)]

s = Solver()

# Symmetry and irreflexivity
for i in range(12):
    s.add(Not(X[i][i]))
    for j in range(i+1, 12):
        s.add(X[i][j] == X[j][i])

# Min degree >= 1, Max degree <= 2
for i in range(12):
    degree = Sum([If(X[i][j], 1, 0) for j in range(12)])
    s.add(degree >= 1)
    s.add(degree <= 2)

# Edges between 9 and 11
total_edges = Sum([If(X[i][j], 1, 0) for i in range(12) for j in range(i+1, 12)])
s.add(total_edges >= 9)
s.add(total_edges <= 11)

# Known edges
s.add(X[5][7] == True)
s.add(X[4][6] == True)

# Chromatic number == 2
# This means it's bipartite and has at least one edge.
# Since min degree >= 1, it has at least one edge, so chromatic number >= 2 is satisfied if it's bipartite.
# Bipartite means we can color vertices with 0 and 1 such that no edge connects same color.
color = [Int(f"c_{i}") for i in range(12)]
for i in range(12):
    s.add(Or(color[i] == 0, color[i] == 1))
    for j in range(i+1, 12):
        s.add(Implies(X[i][j], color[i] != color[j]))

                edges.append((i, j))
    print(edges)
